passed.evidence: tools/list includes list_deck_archetypes and explain_deck_spec. Archetype catalogue returns six entries with summaries, default_template, executive. board_update resolves midnight-blue in explain. Explain returns per-slide roles, density, selected layout/pattern, alternatives, rhythm, layout_coverage and deck_id without rendering.

cycle-figure-eight exposes min_content_width_pt=580, min_content_height_pt=140, narrow_fallback=refused, segment_only=false. use_when calls for full-width slide/band; not_when excludes half-width segments under about 580pt and suggests cycle-ring. 4-8 phases, each lobe 2-4; left_count defaults half rounded up. Labels max 26, descriptions max 60, tightened to 40 when a lobe holds four. Body default 12pt, header default 14 stepping to 12. Actual text still needs validation.

cycle-ring exposes narrow_fallback=legend, fallback_below_width_pt=450, segment_only=false. Unset labels select legend below threshold; explicit labels override transition. Short legend can omit descriptions with warning. 4-8 phases, default clockwise/segments/regular; description budgets 90 for 4, 70 for 5-6, 50 for 7-8; label 28 for 4-6, 24 for 7-8.

Recommendation discovers kpi-inline and distinguishes compact supporting bar from kpi-4up. show_pattern exposes segment_only=true, narrow_fallback=none and SLIDE_UNDERUSED risk alone. 2-6 metrics; big max 8, small max 40, sub max 12. Caption budgets tighten by count/icon/delta. Default open for plain cells, tinted with icons, semantic_accent or nonuniform accents. Raw-only data contract supplied.

args.intent: Show a two-loop learning cycle beside explanatory text on one slide; the cycle occupies half the slide width.

Rationale says needs slide width, but candidate contains no structured min-width/narrow-fallback or explicit refusal; recipe is standalone. show_pattern later clearly refuses this area and suggests ring/full width.
friction.impact: An agent following the top runnable recommendation can miss the spatial constraint before validation.
